scope: Original editable game projects for every canonical Dragon console/PC target, bounded real native asset codecs, target-aware validation, exact source/build handoff and explicit deterministic design-scene simulation

original_authoring: Imports are explicit original-authored typed assets with author/source SHA and transformation receipts. ROM ingestion never extracts commercial ROM assets into projects. Data and source edits remain inert; native compilation/execution is delegated to the existing fixed approved toolchain/core boundaries. Actual bounded PNG and PCM WAVE source decoding binds measured geometry/sample identities; asset transforms preserve original-source and exact operation provenance.
constraints: Canonical target identity/resolution/colors/toolchain/status are reused exactly. Published known tile/VRAM/bank/endianness constraints are distinguished from conservative editor capacity caps; undeclared physical RAM and binary compatibility remain unavailable, never fabricated. Native map chunk exports preserve actual entry formats, CGB separate attributes and NES2x2 palette attributes; unsupported NES/DMG flips bake original tiles into bounded native pattern slots. Source headers and RGBDS db tables are actual encoded data, but inclusion/scrolling/bank placement remains explicit source integration, never claimed automatic compilation.
simulation: Typed editor scene/layers/tiles/entities/controllers/audio drive a bounded local fixed-step 2D design simulation with actual collision, hazard/goal/progress rewards and actual raster/audio previews. It is never hardware emulation or proof of console compatibility. Source/script text is not executed.
failure: Unknown targets/formats, incompatible palette/tile/bank references, malformed/truncated assets, out-of-bounds cells/entities/audio, stale file manifests and conflicting edit IDs fail before returning a candidate manifest. No caller-supplied flag grants hardware or promotion authority.
verification: User-directed implementation session prohibits automated tests. Source formatting/lint/syntax checks and productive original authoring/simulation/build work are allowed; no acceptance or complete hardware claim follows from source implementation alone.

scene_graph.scope: Optional exact-manifest-bound authored hierarchy, sprite atlas timeline, finite variables and nonrecursive typed event/region/input/tick rule graph, executed by existing design scene simulation. Native ROM kernel excludes graph mechanics unless explicit fixed source integration proves them.
scene_graph.runtime: Fixed60Hz exact tick animation; translations affect actual entity collision and raster geometry. Rules read immutable trigger event snapshot, so emitted events cannot recursively dispatch more rules within one tick. Current variable/economy/visibility state and fired rule identities bind replay/transition digests. Emitted custom events deduplicate into at most1024 next-tick names; event cycles are explicit in inspection and remain bounded by64rules/cooldown/episode steps, with no recursive same-tick dispatch. Rule property overrides take precedence over timeline channels until reset. Moving platforms block according to animated geometry but do not carry a standing player. Policy observations expose14 existing scene features plus first18 lexicallyordered graphvariable IDs; remaining variables remain fullreplay state but are explicitly partiallyobserved, preserving existing32feature learner cap.
scene_graph.state_authority: Same existing project file manifest/CAS and bounded replay snapshot, no new persistence owner
scene_graph.metrics_scope: Measured structure/reference/cycle/economy limits and actual rule fire/action counters, not hardware behavior or game quality
scene_graph.verification: Source static checks and productive original authoring/play only; no automated tests per user.

native_graph_compiler.scope: Actual DMG bounded graph hierarchy translations/visibility and fixedtick8x8 original atlas sprite timelines compile into trusted native ROM frame tables consumed by fixed RGBDS kernel. Goal marker position/visibility follows same native table; unsupported variables/rules fail explicit before source binding.
native_graph_compiler.timelines: All loops share one duration at most128ticks; nonloops share bounded horizon at most127ticks. Mixed loop/nonloop rejected. Translation evaluated at every native phase must be an exact integer and composed pose within authored world. Rendering subset does not confer unsupported entity physics or gameplay rules.
native_graph_compiler.instrumentation: Only exact current trusted kernel+assets+graph/document source binding can issue a named read-only SYSTEM_RAM layout for Gambatte/FCEUmm. Native observed bytes must be measured through existing isolated host; metadata alone is never gameplay evidence. Fixed boot signature rejects incorrect memory mapping. Boot signature at GBoffset18/NESoffset15 is allowed64bounded native bootstrap runs, then enforced. Competing native source files/custom build controls cause exact binding refusal; source metadata cannot instrument a different compiled cartridge.
limitations: Native graph variables/rules require a later explicit compiler port
Animated entity physics, NPC/farming interactions and hardware music remain deferred
